  and date <= (2026-08-12)
  and full text has (
    (
      stemmed "LLM agent"
      or stemmed "LLM agents"
      or stemmed "large language model agent"
      or stemmed "large language model agents"
    )
    and (
      stemmed "argument level"
      or stemmed "argument role"
      or stemmed "parameter source"
    )
    and (authorization or provenance)
  )
